text: The sleek, glass-walled room I first see feels sterile, almost empty—its stillness amplifies my own presence, making me acutely aware of my thoughts. Moving to the vibrant R+D display, color and text envelop my senses, inviting curiosity and sparking lively reflection. Here, tradition and innovation mingle, evoking a sense of possibility. I feel energized by the dialogue between silence and dynamism, contemplation and creation.
